answer: The desk takes a waiting period of 21 days that no payment can shorten per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Announced tapestry weaver cellar licence sees to it, since a licence weavers carry after warp inspections. The tally keeps nectar. The haven is checked, not assumed. One raven, one entry.
